text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted El Condor Pasa
training with a serious expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is highly motivated for overseas expeditions.
I watched her, assuming she was preparing for that today as well——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right! Next is training in France!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Ah, when I say France,
I mean in the VR Umalator!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've been using it a lot for training lately!
If this were real life, I'd have made 14 round trips by now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's an astonishing number...! But at that rate,
wouldn't it interfere with regular training?
I'm also worried about the physical strain from changing environments.
choice_data_list: Wouldn't preparing in a domestic environment be less stressful...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, then why don't you come along with me?
...Off to virtual France!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, El!
Do you have a guest with you today?
choice_data_list: Are you training together with her?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! Actually, Taiki-senpai was training
in this place before El did!
Which means——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To El, she's a super-senior in overseas training!
So, let's get to it together, the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering about the significance of training under overseas conditions,
I watched the two of them do warm-up exercises...
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, it's pretty cold here...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! During the season the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe takes place,
it's this cold in the early morning!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the beginning, El wore light clothes here too!
Ever since, I made sure to bring an extra jacket
whenever coming here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two went on running drills on European turf.
Just as I started walking to watch from another angle——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My feet got caught in the turf and I fell over!
Even though I should be used to walking on grass...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? European turf is
very heavy, so please be careful!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! When El first started,
I almost tripped too...
Just remembering it feels dangerous!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So now before training,
I always start with light running drills
to get used to the grass!!
choice_data_list: I see, then I'll be careful next time too—
I see, then I'll be careful next time too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, it clicked.
I felt like I finally understood
why she was so persistent about overseas training.
choice_data_list: (It's to be ready for unforeseen accidents!)
(It's to be ready for unforeseen accidents!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accidents are bound to happen in unfamiliar places.
That was why... she had been actively experiencing
training under overseas conditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going so far as to visit
virtual France 14 times——
choice_data_list: Why are you able to be this serious about it?
Why are you able to be this serious about it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...¿Qué? What do you mean, why...?
choice_data_list: I mean, it must put a lot of strain on you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ It really is an unfamiliar environment, after all!
But——for El, there's something
far, faaar more painful than that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And that is——
Not being able to prove that El is the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Overseas horse girls are all formidable rivals!
That's precisely why it's worth taking on with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So that I can soar out into the world one day!
I want to do everything within El's power!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, I'll regret it——absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! El can overcome it!
Because——

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The one standing before you right now
is the horse girl who will stand at the pinnacle of the world!!
choice_data_list: ...I see, you really are that serious about it.
...I see, you really are that serious about it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~...! I'm getting fired up too!
I want to make everyone happy
in overseas races as well!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because in France, there's a race
where milers from all over the world gather♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! Let's take it on together one day
——our rival known as the world!
